notes.title: 🎮 Patch 1.0.2 – Steam Achievements + Lyra Image Fix + More!
notes.content:
💙✨ PATCH 1.0.2 – Steam Achievements, Lyra Fix & More!
🎉 First of all… THANK YOU!
Over 600 people have added the demo to their libraries, almost 100 players have already taken their first steps into this strange university, and more than 100 wishlists are already waiting for what comes next.
As the creator of this romantic anime-style visual novel, that means everything to me. 🥹🌸

This is my first time ever uploading a game to Steam, and I'm still learning programming as I go. So yes, bugs were expected. But with your support, I’m patching things faster than a speedrunner skipping dialogue.

💬 Most of the feedback has come from our Discord community and Facebook page — and let me tell you, your bug reports and kind words are GREAT.🎮

⚠️ Quick reminder: I have a full-time job and work on this during my (very limited) free time. This VN is made with pure passion, not profit. So patches will come… but slowly. The full release is planned for August 2026.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ What's been fixed in this patch?
🔹 Lyra (human version) was accidentally showing up in JPG (and huge!) in some scenes. That’s been replaced with the correct PNG.

🔹 Fixed the bug where no music would play after the protagonist's dream (mid-story).

🔹 Steam achievements now work! 🏆
Go claim them! Except for one hidden music-related one… I am still investigating that mystery 👀🎵

🔹 You can now move between pages in the Save/Load menus.
(Still working on better button placement there.)

🔹 Fixed a crash when the music playlist in the main menu was empty. It won't happen anymore.
[hr][/hr]
📌 Want to report bugs or chat with the dev?

Thanks again for all your support. You’re not just playing a VN…
You’re helping build it. 🌌💞
– LeoShiro
